what: After 30s with no input (no keys, mouse movement, presses, finger drags, or scroll), a full-screen overlay appears and one card shows up on it at random, .5s power2.inOut. Once the overlay is up, any input dismisses it (.3s on wide screens, instant under 800px) and the timer restarts. Pressing the open button skips the wait and shows it after .05s, but so the same press doesn’t dismiss it right away, input is ignored for 1.1s (.1s under 450px).

options.idle: Seconds to wait with no touch, default 30
options.dur: Duration for panel/card to appear and clear (s), default .5
options.open: CSS selector of the button that opens immediately on press (searched across the whole document), default none
options.hide-delay: Time from the panel appearing to input arriving and retracting (ms), default 300 on wide screens · 0 under 800px
options.guard: Time in ms during which input is ignored when opened with the open button, default 1100 · 100 below 450px
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Card that shows only one at random (only the board shows if none)
options.fx:open / fx:close: Event fired from the element when a board rises or retracts (detail.card is the chosen card)

from.where: shared.js·shared.css .y-saver — four record cards over a large navy text background (original screenSaver: 30s · keydown mousemove click touchmove scroll, autoAlpha .5s power2.inOut, clear delay 300ms above 801px, pressing the last line (#endSec__saver) opens it after 50ms and ignores input for 1100ms above 451px)

note: The original listens only to window scroll — the part listens to scroll in the capture phase so scrolling inside inner panels also clears it. With reduced motion it turns on with length 0 and clears (the panel still appears)
